title: Wedding SVG Bundle,20 Designs
author: SimaCrafts
description:
DIGITAL DOWNLOAD ONLY
Your download includes one .zip file with the following files:
SVG-20: Digital cut file – use this file if you have Cricut Design Space or Silhouette Studio Designer Edition.
EPS-20: File (Vector and fully editable).
PNG-20: This is a high resolution image file with a transparent background, so you can use for heat transfer paper to create iron ons, Dye-Sublimated printing, or the Print and Cut feature on(300 Dpi Background transparent). your machine
DXF-20: Use this file if you are using a Silhouette cutting machine and do not have Silhouette Studio Designer Edition.
Ai-20: File.(Adobe illustrator source file).
JPG-20: This is the same as a PNG except it has a white background instead of transparent
| COMPATIBLE WITH |
Cricut: Silhouette: Inkscape: Adobe Photoshop: Adobe Illustrator
If there is any problem with the files, please contact me asap, Will be happy to help you!.
